Elaine: T-minus 35 for the hotfix window (21:00 UTC). PR #8347 addresses the KV cache mem leak. CI is green but we need a second sign-off before cutoff — can someone grab a quick review? @simon @jamie :eyes:
Simon: I'll take a look in ~10m, ping me if I don't post by 21:00.
Jamie: I'm standing by as merge-owner, short on cycles but can give the final ok if it's small.
Sanjay: I see one flaky smoke failure locally, pushing a tiny fix (should be a one-line change).
Elaine: If it's a tiny fix we can cherry-pick it into the release branch after merge. @deploy-bot can you hold canary until we have two approvals?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary hold applied for PR 8347 — rollout paused.
Simon: Quick review done. Left a non-blocking comment about a null check; otherwise looks safe. Example nit: ```if (ctx && ctx.kv) { /* handle */ }```
Sanjay: Pushed the fix and amended the PR, CI retriggered: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/8347/checks :thumbsup:
Jamie: Re-reviewed the updated diff, all good from my side. ACK, second sign-off granted. :white_check_mark:
Elaine: Brilliant — merge when green. I'll monitor canary and stand by for rollback if anything odd shows up. ETA: merge in ~2 minutes.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Merge queued. Canary scheduled for 21:05 UTC. Will post to #eng-sre on any anomalies.
